items.title: 1.8 Na aur Mg ke pani, oxygen aur chlorine se reactions (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 1.8, printed page 15.

blocks.text: Sodium, group 1 mein, aur magnesium, group 2 mein, dono pani, oxygen aur chlorine se react karte hain, magar har soorat mein sodium zyada reactive metal hai. Un ke reactions, jo agle teen topics mein ek ek kar ke liye gaye hain, period 3 mein dhaati kirdar ka rujhan dikhate hain: sodium, ek valence electron, bare atom aur kam ionization energy ke saath, magnesium se zyada asani se apna electron khota hai.

blocks.alt: Period 3 ke anasir sodium se chlorine tak ka chart. Ek narangi patti un ke oxides oxidation numbers ke saath list karti aur unhen basic, amphoteric ya acidic batati hai; ek neeli patti un ke chlorides, pani mein neutral ya acidic. Neeche do box: sodium aur magnesium ke pani, oxygen aur chlorine ke saath muadlat (equations), aur oxides aur chlorides ke acid-base muadlat.
blocks.caption: Period 3 ke oxides aur chlorides, aur sodium aur magnesium ke reactions (Table 1.2 aur topics 1.8 se 1.10 ke muadlat ke mutabiq asal chart).
blocks.long_description: Sodium pani se zor se react kar ke sodium hydroxide aur hydrogen deta hai, magnesium aahista, agarche bhaap (steam) se yeh magnesium oxide deta hai; dono oxygen mein jalte hain, sodium sunehri shole se peroxide tak aur magnesium shadeed safed shole se oxide tak; dono chlorine se safed chlorides dete hain. Period ke saath oxides basic ionic lattices (sodium, magnesium) se amphoteric aluminium oxide se ho kar acidic covalent molecules (silicon se sulfur) tak jate hain, chlorides neutral ionic namak se covalent compounds tak jo hydrolyse ho kar acidic mahlool dete hain, aur oxidation numbers group ke valence electrons ke saath +1 se +6 tak barhte hain.

blocks.prompt: Teen reactions parhne se pehle peshgoi karein ke sodium aur magnesium mein kaun thande pani se tez react karta hai aur kyun.
blocks.explanation: Sodium: yeh magnesium se bara hai, kam pehli ionization energy rakhta hai aur sirf ek electron khona hai, to zyada dhaati aur zyada reactive hai, aur zor se react karta hai jab ke magnesium aahista.

items: Sodium aur magnesium dono pani, oxygen aur chlorine se react karte hain; sodium apne zyada dhaati kirdar ki wajah se zyada reactive hai.
